text:
mira: heads up — since kernel-5.19 roll yesterday we're seeing short ECC/Xid bursts on ~3 nodes, DCGM exporter spikes. Alerts fired 12x in last 30m.
alex: can you paste alert lines? what's the current Prom rule?
mira: current rule is:
```
alert: GPU_ECC_Xid_Spike
expr: increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[1m]) > 0
for: 0m
```
it's too sensitive, we get one-off blips triggering noise
sam: agreed. we should coalesce by gpu_uuid and add a window + count. try `increase(...[5m]) >= 3` or use `rate(...)`
alex: another option: add a recording rule `gpu_xid_rate = increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[5m])` then alert when `gpu_xid_rate > gpu_baseline_threshold` where baseline is computed per-gpu via historical percentiles
mira: can we run a POC on the canary GPU pool? label them `gpu_group=canary` and route to #eng-oncall only. less blast radius
ops-bot: deploy started — prometheus/rules/pr-342 applied to canary (CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/342)
sam: also consider Alertmanager-side suppression: group by `gpu_uuid, node`, set `group_interval: 5m` and `repeat_interval: 1h` so repeated blips don't wake oncall
alex: let's also compute a `card_flake_score` recorded metric: decay over 1h, bump on Xid/ECC, reduce on clean windows; if score > 0.75 mark as `drain_candidate`
mira: i'll open PR with recording rules + new alert variant (warning severity) for canary and a stricter production rule. will run for 24h and report results. tagging @sam @alex
sam: sounds good — if noise drops we can update runbook: only escalate on `for: 10m` or `severity: critical` and use `drain_candidate` label to queue manual triage :thumbsup:
ops-bot: prometheus configlint OK, rule test: PASS
